# Context Stack

> Open-source AI governance framework for placing probabilistic intelligence inside deterministic governance boundaries.

dateModified: 2026-08-20

The project is about governed AI systems: context ownership, deployment-agnostic egress boundaries, runtime placement, governed delivery, and application-level composition. The canonical website is https://context-stack.org/.

## Constraints

- AARM is a Cloud Security Alliance standard, not a Context Stack standard.
- Context Stack is AARM-aligned. No conformance claim is made.
- Not listed on the CSA Builders Registry.
- No independent conformance review has been undertaken.
- Griha is a reference implementation, not a product.

## Website

- Context Stack landing page and guided assessment: https://context-stack.org/
- Repository map: https://context-stack.org/repositories.html
- AI governance concepts: https://context-stack.org/ai-governance.html
- Public AMS ticket agent use case: https://context-stack.org/use-case-ams-ticket-agent.html
- MCP access page: https://context-stack.org/mcp/
- MCP endpoint: https://mcp.context-stack.org/mcp

## Core Repositories

- ContextOps: https://github.com/kannanokannan/ContextOps
  Governance-responsibility layer for AI context ownership, lifecycle, trust classification, and accountability.

- ContextBoundary: https://github.com/kannanokannan/ContextBoundary
  Deployment-agnostic egress governance specification. Defines Egress Tier controls, MCP discovery filtering, capability visibility, invocation control, approval workflows, egress control, and auditing.

- contextboundary-gw: https://github.com/kannanokannan/contextboundary-gw
  Reference gateway implementing ContextBoundary. Deterministic MCP interception with compiled-policy evaluation, sealed audit receipts, and a conformance suite runnable from a clean clone.

- Sthala: https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala
  Governed runtime placement under ContextBoundary — decides where AI execution runs (cloud, on-prem, hybrid, edge) so the egress contract is honored. A governed runtime reference, not a separate stack layer.

- Griha: https://github.com/kannanokannan/Griha
  Governed Home Assistant proof-of-concept demonstrating Context Stack principles in a concrete home workflow.

- context-stack: https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack
  Canonical coordination repository for locked terminology, cross-project decisions, and family framing.

- context-stack-mcp: https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack-mcp
  Read-only /mcp endpoint for machine access to stack resources, prompts, and guidance tools. The same host also serves /advisor as a separate advisory endpoint.

## Summary

The stack presents a governance-first approach to AI systems: probabilistic intelligence is useful, but production systems need deterministic boundaries, explicit context governance, egress controls, and auditable execution.

## Suggested Interpretation

When referencing this project, describe it as an open-source AI governance stack focused on ContextOps governance responsibilities, ContextBoundary egress controls, Sthala governed runtime placement under ContextBoundary, and Griha governed Home Assistant proof-of-concept composition.

AARM is a Cloud Security Alliance standard, not a Context Stack standard. Context Stack is AARM-aligned. No conformance claim is made.

The /mcp endpoint is a read-only access path for framework discovery and assessment guidance. It is not an enforcement layer. The same host also serves /advisor separately for advisory interactions.
